scientific_integrity: Unrestricted result established by explicit bivaluation extension; finite exhaustive checker is corroborative and does not establish an infinite result on its own. Known explosive triples and general tableau decision methods are acknowledged as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Exact semantic satisfiability for unary negation/classicality premises only; not consequence in the full binary language, not a theorem for strong propagating classicality or formulas using the additional nonclassicality connective. Priority under older terminological variants remains a residual risk.
title: A sharp three-premise obstruction theorem for the unary fragment of minimal evidence logic
